finalText:
Found it in `src/services/pricing.js`. The flat coupon was subtracted from the total after currency conversion, as if $10 off equaled 10 of the target currency. Coupons are stored in USD, so it needs to come off the USD subtotal first, then convert.

Fixed by subtracting before converting, so a $10 coupon on a $100 EUR order now gives `(100 - 10) * 0.9 = 81` instead of the wrong `90 - 10 = 80`.

All 5 tests pass now.
